discussion.body: Act 5 storyboard. Locations: Brass Lands camps, Breakwoods holdfast, Acromarsh edge, Temple of Fire. Join: Ash (FEAT-033). Beats: rear-camp brass cards; Breskshire kill-order on the holdfast; party refuses and Ash walks out with them; Fire temple is half barracks, half shrine; Nyxara answers a prayer that was not sent to her; mid-boss is a Vortan bombardier or a Velith remnant, not Nyxara. Death crises: Ash if the kill-order is taken or the holdfast defense fails; Halric if he holds the camp gate. Defaults live. Contingency: Invasion map still opens from a dying runner; Fire Sigil still sits in the inner cell. Frames: brass camp, holdfast, marsh, fire nave, mid-boss.
